Definition: Kish, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Kish = "bent"; 1) a Benjamite of the family of Matri, father of king Saul; 2) an ancestor of Mordecai; 3) son of Gibeon and brother of Abdon, Zur, Baal, Ner, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth; uncle of Kish the father of king Saul; 4) a Merarite Levite, son of Mahli and grandson of Merari the progenitor of the family; 5) a Merarite Levite, son of Abdi in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah
